featured_projects.title: The 2026 NeuroGolf Championship
featured_projects.description: Bronze Medal-winning Kaggle competition project focused on optimizing ONNX model portfolios for high-scoring, reproducible submissions.
features: Designed 400 ONNX models that improved the portfolio score by 618%, from 1,036 to 7,436.96, through joint optimization of parameters, memory, and MACs
Built a reproducible model-compilation and evaluation pipeline for 941 leaderboard submissions with content-hashed provenance and ONNX correctness gates
Applied INT8 quantization, signed-logit encoding, crop-process-reconstruct architectures, and depthwise convolutions to reduce parameters by about 10x while preserving exact functional correctness

featured_projects.title: EleVox
featured_projects.description: Bioacoustic signal-recovery system that separates elephant rumbles from heavy environmental noise to recover interpretable signals about behavior, stress, and movement.
features: Built for HackSMU VII as a bioacoustics-focused AI project
Used a category-aware harmonic-plus-noise pipeline to separate elephant calls from vehicles, generators, and aircraft noise
Processed annotated field recordings and recovered biologically meaningful low-frequency rumble structure
Won Best Use of DigitalOcean Gradient AI
featured_projects.achievement: Winner · Best Use of DigitalOcean Gradient AI

Mapped real-time user intent into robotic-arm actions without mouse or keyboard
Focused on practical assistive interaction for users with limited mobility
